title: Decide and document the MVP architecture (ADR-0001)
body:
✅ ADR-0001 accepted; monorepo implemented.

Source: *Suggestions for Your Project* doc proposes Next.js + Node/Express or Django + PostgreSQL on AWS (Cognito, S3, Lambda/EC2, SES). Pick one path and record it as an ADR so the team stops re-debating.

See `docs/adr/0001-stack.md` (proposed).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] ADR reviewed and marked Accepted
- [ ] Diagram of components committed to `docs/architecture.md`
- [ ] Monorepo layout agreed (`apps/web`, `apps/api`, `infra`, `db`)

title: Monorepo bootstrap: Next.js web + API + shared types + lint/test
body:
✅ Done: apps/api, apps/web, Vitest, CI. Remaining: shared types package, ESLint/Prettier, husky.

Create `apps/web` (Next.js + Tailwind), `apps/api` (Node/TS, Fastify or Express), `packages/shared` (zod schemas/types). Add ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, husky + lint-staged, `.nvmrc`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `npm ci && npm test` green in CI
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks run
- [ ] README quick-start works on a clean machine

title: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) for dev/staging/prod
body:
Provision Cognito, RDS Postgres, S3 (private + CloudFront), SES, Lambda/ECS, Secrets Manager. Separate AWS accounts or at least separate stacks per env.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `terraform plan` runs in CI on PRs
- [ ] Staging deployable from `main` automatically
- [ ] Prod deploy requires manual approval

title: CI/CD: lint, test, build, preview deploys, migrations
body:
✅ CI (typecheck/test/build/gitleaks) exists. Remaining: preview deploys, deploy + migration job, branch protection.

Extend `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Add preview environments per PR and a migration job (e.g. node-pg-migrate / Flyway) that runs before deploy.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] PR shows preview URL
- [ ] Failed migration blocks deploy
- [ ] Branch protection on `main` enabled (required checks, 1 review)

title: Secrets management & repo security baseline
body:
Enable secret scanning + push protection, Dependabot alerts, CodeQL, `SECURITY.md`. Use AWS Secrets Manager / GitHub OIDC (no long-lived keys). **Any PAT ever pasted in chat must be revoked.**

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] CodeQL workflow green
- [ ] No static AWS keys in GitHub secrets (OIDC role)
- [ ] SECURITY.md published

title: Replace `password_hash` auth with Cognito / OIDC
body:
✅ API already verifies OIDC JWTs (`AUTH_MODE=oidc`) and has no password column. Remaining: create the Cognito pool, hosted UI/Google login in the web app, MFA.

The draft schema stores `Users.password_hash`. Rolling our own auth is avoidable risk; the doc itself suggests Cognito/Firebase. Store only `auth_sub`. Support email + Google sign-in, MFA for agencies/HR admins.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Users table has no password column
- [ ] Login via email and Google works
- [ ] Role claim (`newcomer|hr|agency|admin`) enforced by API middleware

title: Schema v1: review and adopt `db/migrations/0001_init.sql`
body:
✅ Migration applied by tests and CI. Remaining: team review, ERD, richer seed.

The v0 schema (from the doc) works but has gaps: no enums/FK actions/indexes, `Favorites` without uniqueness, price without currency, no geo, contact info mixed with public profile, opt-out instead of opt-in contact. A v1 draft is committed — review, tweak, and make it the baseline.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Team review done
- [ ] Seed data script (`db/seed.sql`) for Bogotá demo
- [ ] ERD generated and added to docs

title: Newcomer: signup, profile (city of contract, arrival date, preferences)
body:
✅ API + page implemented (`PUT /newcomer/profile`, consent log, invite claiming). Remaining: multi-step wizard, validation UX.

As a newcomer I register (email/Google), complete my profile and set housing preferences (budget, bedrooms, furnished, districts) so I can be matched.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Wizard < 3 min
- [ ] Profile editable
- [ ] Consent for sharing with agencies captured (`consents` table)

title: Newcomer: property search with filters + map + save favorites
body:
✅ Filters + favorites implemented. Remaining: map view, URL-persisted filters, pagination UI.

Filters: city/district, price range, type, bedrooms, furnished, available-from. Map view (Google Maps/MapLibre). Favorites (unique per newcomer/property).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Search p95 < 500 ms on 10k listings
- [ ] Filters in URL (shareable)
- [ ] Favorites persist across devices

title: HR: company account and relocation dashboard
body:
✅ Dashboard with stage summary implemented. Remaining: multiple HR users per company, stage history, Kanban.

HR admin creates company, invites HR colleagues, sees every newcomer with `relocation_stage` (invited → moved in) as a Kanban/list. Source: 'HR Dashboard' suggestion.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Stage change history kept
- [ ] Filters by arrival date and stage
- [ ] Role-based access within a company

title: HR: add newcomers manually and via CSV import
body:
✅ Implemented with per-row error report + dedupe. Remaining: invitation e-mails, downloadable error CSV.

CSV template download, row-level validation report, dedupe by email, invitation emails sent via SES with claim link (newcomer owns the account afterwards).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Import 500 rows < 30 s
- [ ] Errors downloadable as CSV
- [ ] Invite link single-use and expires

title: Agency: onboarding, profile and verification request
body:
✅ Create agency + admin verify endpoints. Remaining: document upload (NIT/RUT), admin UI, multiple users per agency.

Agency registers free, uploads business registration (RUT/NIT in Colombia), requests verification. Admin reviews.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Admin queue for verification
- [ ] Status badge visible
- [ ] Multiple users per agency

title: Agency: property CRUD with photos on S3 (pre-signed uploads)
body:
✅ CRUD implemented. Remaining: S3 pre-signed photo upload, thumbnails, EXIF stripping.

Create/edit listings with up to N photos; browser uploads directly to S3 with pre-signed URLs; thumbnails generated; EXIF GPS stripped.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Image size/type validated server-side
- [ ] Reorder photos
- [ ] Listing can be paused/archived

title: Matching v1: rule-based newcomer ↔ listing score and notifications
body:
✅ Implemented and unit-tested (`docs/matching.md`).

Doc says: don't over-build matching; start with rules. Score on city, budget, type, bedrooms, furnished, availability vs arrival date, district preference. Fan-out to `notifications` (deduped) on newcomer create/update and on new listing.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Score 0–100 documented and unit-tested
- [ ] Agency feed sorted by score
- [ ] Newcomer gets 'new match' notification

title: Blurred leads: enforce contact privacy SERVER-side
body:
✅ Implemented with leak tests and audit log. Remaining: rate limit tuning, pen-test.

The draft says 'blur in the frontend'. CSS blur leaks data in the DOM/network tab. API must not return name/email/phone unless agency has an active plan or credit AND `allow_contact` is true. Data lives in `newcomer_contacts`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Integration test: unsubscribed agency never receives contact fields
- [ ] Every reveal logged in `contact_unlocks` + `audit_logs`
- [ ] Rate limit on reveals

title: Transactional email: invites, welcome, new match (SES + templates)
body:
React-email/MJML templates in EN/ES/PT. Bounce/complaint handling via SNS.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Unsubscribe link on non-transactional mail
- [ ] Suppression list respected

title: i18n: English, Spanish (CO) and Portuguese across web app
body:
Marketing docs mention contact in PT/ES/EN and BPO audiences in Bogotá. Use next-intl; default by browser, persisted in `users.locale`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No hard-coded strings
- [ ] Language switcher
- [ ] Currency/date formatting per locale

title: Accessibility & performance budget (WCAG 2.2 AA, Lighthouse ≥ 90)
body:
Add axe + Lighthouse CI to the pipeline.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Keyboard-only flows pass
- [ ] CI fails if score < 90

title: E2E tests for the three golden paths (Playwright)
body:
1) HR adds newcomer → agency sees blurred lead. 2) Agency subscribes → contact revealed. 3) Newcomer finds & favorites a listing.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Run on every PR against preview env

title: Agency monetization: freemium credits (5/mo) + Pro + Enterprise via Stripe/MercadoPago
body:
✅ Credits + signed idempotent webhook implemented. Remaining: checkout flow, customer portal, dunning, Enterprise seats.

Free: unlimited listings + 5 contact credits/month. Pro: unlimited contacts, analytics, boosts. Enterprise: seats, API, CRM integration. Use MercadoPago/PSE for Colombia, Stripe for cards. Webhooks are source of truth.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Idempotent webhook handler
- [ ] Credits reset monthly via scheduled job
- [ ] Dunning emails for past_due

title: Verification & trust layer: 'Bogoboom Verified' listings and agencies
body:
Photo proof, geo-check (listing coordinates vs photo EXIF/GPS or video-call), contract template. Badge on listing and agency.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Verification checklist in admin
- [ ] Badge shown in search results
- [ ] Revocation flow

title: Reviews & ratings of agencies by newcomers/HR
body:
Only users with a `moved_in` or `contract_signed` relationship can review; moderation queue; agency can reply once.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] One review per author/agency
- [ ] Abuse report button

title: In-app messaging between subscribed agency and newcomer/HR
body:
Conversations table; websockets/SSE; email fallback; attachment scanning; block/report.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Only subscribed agencies can start threads
- [ ] Read receipts
- [ ] Spam/abuse rate limits

title: HR: bulk housing request to agencies + preferred districts + company policies
body:
Send one request for N newcomers; set company-preferred districts and budget caps; agencies respond with shortlists.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Responses tracked per newcomer
- [ ] Budget caps enforced in matching

title: Document vault for newcomers (visa, contract letter) with expiring signed links
body:
Encrypted at rest (SSE-KMS), malware scan on upload, explicit per-agency sharing, downloads logged (`Downloads` in doc).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No public S3 URLs
- [ ] Download audit trail visible to owner

title: Privacy & compliance: Colombia Ley 1581, LGPD (BR users/HR), GDPR-style rights
body:
Consent log, data export & delete endpoints, retention policy, DPA with agencies, cookie consent. Opt-in contact (draft default was opt-out). Needs legal review.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Delete-my-data works end-to-end
- [ ] Privacy policy matches actual processing
- [ ] DPO/contact published

title: Agency analytics: leads viewed, contacted, conversion to contract
body:
Funnel dashboard for Pro plan; CSV export.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Metrics definitions documented

title: AI matching v2 and conversational assistant 'MIRA' for newcomers
body:
Brand mascot MIRA (headset avatar) answers relocation questions in EN/ES/PT, explains neighborhoods, drafts messages to agencies, and can pre-fill preferences. Build on Claude with retrieval over curated city guides. Guardrails: no legal advice, cite sources, escalate to human.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Eval set of 50 questions
- [ ] PII redaction before logging
- [ ] Handoff to human/agency

title: Integration with MIRA job portal / MRE-AI: 'got the job → plan the move'
body:
Per the project vision, candidates found via the Miratech portal flow into Bogoboom with contract city and start date prefilled (HR consent required). Define shared identity and API contract.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Signed webhook/API contract documented
- [ ] One-click 'Plan my relocation' from job offer

title: Affiliate marketplace: furniture rental, internet, banking, SIM
body:
Post-contract checklist with partner offers; track referral commissions.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Partner onboarding flow
- [ ] Attribution report

title: Market insights product (aggregated rent trends by district)
body:
Anonymised/aggregated only (k-anonymity ≥ 10).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Data-use policy reviewed by legal

title: Multi-city & multi-country expansion framework (Medellín, CDMX, São Paulo…)
body:
Intro doc promises 'anywhere in the world'. Make `city`/`country` first-class (cities table, currency, locale, legal pack per country).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Add a new city via config + data only
- [ ] Per-country legal/consent text

title: Public API + CRM integrations (HubSpot/Salesforce) for Enterprise agencies
body:
API keys, scopes, rate limits, OpenAPI docs, webhooks.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] OpenAPI published
- [ ] Sandbox environment

title: Observability: logs, metrics, tracing, alerts, SLOs
body:
CloudWatch/OTel, Sentry for web and API; SLO: API availability 99.9%.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] On-call runbook
- [ ] Alert on payment webhook failures

title: Fix broken audio-description button markup on landing page
body:
In the current `index.html` the play button has `style="..."` (literal ellipsis) and a stray duplicate `</button>`; the native `<audio controls>` makes the button redundant. Fixed in `site/index.html` — verify and close.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] HTML validator passes
- [ ] Audio has transcript link for accessibility

title: Add consent-gated Google Tag Manager (cookie banner)
body:
GTM currently loads unconditionally. Load it only after analytics consent. Basic banner implemented in `site/index.html`; finish integration with Consent Mode v2 and policy page.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No GTM request before consent
- [ ] Consent can be withdrawn

title: SEO & social: meta description, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, hreflang
body:
Landing page lacks description/OG tags. Add per-language pages and structured data (Organization, WebSite).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Rich preview validated
- [ ] Lighthouse SEO 100

title: Landing pages per persona (HR, Agencies, Newcomers) with lead forms
body:
Links `newcomers_options.html`, `companies_options.html`, `agencies_options.html`, `partnership.html` must exist. Add forms posting to a serverless endpoint (SES/CRM) with spam protection (Turnstile/hCaptcha).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No dead links (CI link check)
- [ ] Leads land in CRM/sheet

title: Agency outreach kit: invitation email sequence + one-pager PDF (EN/ES)
body:
Convert the two Word docs into templates: agency invitation and HR pitch. Fill `[Agency Name]` via mail-merge; add UTM links; track replies. Keep contact details consistent (docs use ronaldo@tecnologiasantos.com.br vs site support@tecnologiasantos.com).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Templates in `docs/marketing/`
- [ ] One canonical contact address

title: Move website images/audio from raw S3 URLs to CloudFront + optimised formats
body:
Serve WebP/AVIF with width variants, immutable cache headers, `loading=lazy`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] LCP < 2.5 s on 4G

title: Pilot programme: sign 3 BPO/tech HR teams and 10 Bogotá agencies
body:
The doc suggests manual matchmaking first (Airbnb-style). Define pilot script, success metrics (time-to-housing, hotel nights saved), feedback loop.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Interview notes in `docs/research/`
- [ ] Pilot KPIs dashboard

title: Existing repo: audit and retire the legacy PHP site/server
body:
`tecnologiasantos/bogoboom` already contains a PHP site/server (config.php, config_login.php, db_connection.php, chatbot.php, change_password.php, partner_inquiry.php …). Audit it before migrating: committed credentials/secrets in code **and git history**, SQL injection, CSRF, password hashing, input validation. Rotate anything exposed.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Findings report in docs/
- [ ] All exposed secrets rotated
- [ ] Plan to migrate users/data to the new schema

title: Data migration from legacy PHP database to schema v1
body:
Map legacy tables to `db/migrations/0001_init.sql`; migrate users without passwords (force Cognito reset/magic link).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Dry-run script + report
- [ ] No plaintext/legacy hashes imported

title: OpenAPI spec + typed client generated for the web app
body:
Generate OpenAPI from zod schemas (e.g. fastify-type-provider-zod + @fastify/swagger) and publish Swagger UI in dev.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `/docs` available in dev
- [ ] Web uses generated client

title: Production-grade auth UI: Cognito hosted login, session refresh, logout everywhere
body:
Replace the dev login page. Keep tokens out of localStorage (httpOnly cookie via BFF) to reduce XSS impact.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No token in localStorage
- [ ] Refresh flow tested

title: Add Playwright E2E to CI using seeded demo data
body:
A browser E2E (agency sees blurred lead → unlock → credit decrements) was run manually; automate it.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Runs on PR with docker-compose
- [ ] Screenshots uploaded on failure

title: Lead list pagination and filters (score, arrival month, stage)
body:
`GET /agency/leads` is capped at 100 rows.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Cursor pagination
- [ ] Filters in UI

title: Retention: purge/anonymise soft-deleted users and old audit logs
body:
Scheduled job honouring the retention policy; export-my-data endpoint.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Job covered by tests
- [ ] Policy documented
